entries.title: Acts 10:1
segments: Now there was at Caesarea a man named Cornelius, a captain in the Italian regiment.

entries.title: Acts 10:2
segments: He was a devout man and God-fearing, and so were all his household. He gave many alms to the people, and constantly prayed to God.

entries.title: Acts 10:3
segments: About three o'clock one afternoon he had a vision, and distinctly saw an angel of God enter his house and say to him, "Cornelius."

entries.title: Acts 10:4
segments: He stared at him in terror, and said, "What is it, Lord?" "Your prayers and your alms have risen for a memorial before God," answered the angel;

entries.title: Acts 10:5
segments: "and now send men to Joppa and fetch one Simon, who is called Peter.

entries.title: Acts 10:6
segments: "He is staying as a guest with Simon, a tanner, whose house is near the sea."

entries.title: Acts 10:7
segments: And after the angel who was speaking to him was gone, he called two of his household servants and a devout soldier who was in constant attendance upon him,

entries.title: Acts 10:8
segments: and after telling them everything, he sent them to Joppa.

entries.title: Acts 10:9
segments: The next day, while they were still on their way and were approaching the town, about noon, Peter went up to the housetop to pray.

entries.title: Acts 10:10
segments: He had become very hungry and longed for food; but while they were preparing it, he fell into a trance.

entries.title: Acts 10:11
segments: He beheld the sky opened, and a vessel descending like an enormous sail let down to earth by four corners.

entries.title: Acts 10:12
segments: In it were all kinds of quadrupeds and creeping things of the earth, and wild birds.

entries.title: Acts 10:13
segments: A voice came to him, saying, "Rise, Peter, kill and eat."

entries.title: Acts 10:14
segments: "Not so, my Lord," answered Peter, "for I have never yet eaten anything common and unclean."

entries.title: Acts 10:15
segments: And again a second time came to him a voice, saying, "What God has cleansed you must not call common."

entries.title: Acts 10:16
segments: This happened three times; and immediately the sail was drawn up into the sky.

entries.title: Acts 10:17
segments: Now while Peter was greatly perplexed to know what the vision which he had been sent by Cornelius, and had made inquiries for the house of Simon, stood at the gate,

entries.title: Acts 10:18
segments: and called and asked whether Simon who was called Peter was lodging there.

entries.title: Acts 10:19
segments: So the Spirit said to Peter, who was still pondering over the vision:

entries.title: Acts 10:20
segments: "Three men are now looking for you. Rise, go down and go with them, nothing doubting; for it is I who have sent them."

entries.title: Acts 10:21
segments: So Peter went down to the men and said: "I am the man you are looking for. What is the reason of your coming?"

entries.title: Acts 10:22
segments: "Cornelius," they answered, "a captain, a devout man, and God-fearing, of whom the whole, Jewish nation speaks well, was instructed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house, and to listen to your message."

entries.title: Acts 10:23
segments: So he invited them in and gave them lodging. The next day he rose, and went off with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied them;

entries.title: Acts 10:24
segments: and the day after that they reached Caesarea. There Cornelius was waiting for them, and had brought together all his relatives and intimate friends.

entries.title: Acts 10:25
segments: When Peter entered the house Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and worshiped him;

entries.title: Acts 10:26
segments: but Peter lifted him up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man, myself."

entries.title: Acts 10:27
segments: And as he talked with him, he went in and found a large company assembled.

entries.title: Acts 10:28
segments: To them he said: "You know, yourselves, that it is illegal for a Jew to associate with or to visit one of another nation; but God has taught me that I should not call any man common or unclean. For this reason, when sent for, I came without demur.

entries.title: Acts 10:29
segments: "I ask therefore why you sent for me."

entries.title: Acts 10:30
segments: Cornelius answered: "Three days ago, at this very hour, I was praying in my house at three o'clock in the afternoon, when suddenly a man in a shining robe stood by me,

entries.title: Acts 10:31
segments: and said: "`Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

entries.title: Acts 10:32
segments: "`So send to Joppa and summon Simon, who is called Peter. He is lodging with Simon the tanner, in a house by the seaside.'

entries.title: Acts 10:33
segments: "So I sent for you without delay, and you have been kind enough to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God, to listen to what the Lord has commanded you to speak."

entries.title: Acts 10:34
segments: Then Peter began to speak: "Of a truth I begin to see quite plainly that God is no respecter of persons;

entries.title: Acts 10:35
segments: "but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

entries.title: Acts 10:36
segments: "You cannot but know the message which he sent to the descendants of Israel, when he preached the gospel of peace by Jesus Christ who is Lord of all;

entries.title: Acts 10:37
segments: "you know the message spread throughout all Judea, beginning in Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

entries.title: Acts 10:38
segments: "how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how he went about everywhere doing good, and curing all who were oppressed by the devil; for God was with him.

entries.title: Acts 10:39
segments: "And we were witnesses of all that he did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him, hanging him on a tree.

entries.title: Acts 10:40
segments: "But him God raised up on the third day, and permitted him to be made manifest,

entries.title: Acts 10:41
segments: "not to all the people, but to witnesses--men previously chosen by God--that is, to us, who ate and drank with him after he had risen from the dead;

entries.title: Acts 10:42
segments: "when he charged us to preach to the people, and to testify that this was he whom God ordained to be the judge of the living and of the dead.

entries.title: Acts 10:43
segments: "To him all the prophets bear witness, testifying that through his name every one that believes on him will receive remission of sins."

entries.title: Acts 10:44
segments: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit fell on all who were listening to the message.

entries.title: Acts 10:45
segments: And all the Jewish believers who had accompanied Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out upon the Gentiles also.

entries.title: Acts 10:46
segments: For they heard them speak with tongues and magnify God.

entries.title: Acts 10:47
segments: Then Peter said, "Can any one refuse water for the baptism of these men who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we?"

entries.title: Acts 10:48
segments: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they begged him to remain with them for a time.
